exceptions.reason: Unmaintained proc-macro dependency of the GTK stack. Not in either macOS graph. Reassess when upstream GTK/Tauri dependencies change.

Tauri GTK/WebKit dependencies require glib 0.18.5 on Linux. The patched 0.20 line is not a compatible lockfile-only update. Neither macOS architecture includes glib; CI rechecks both live dependency graphs. A Linux release is blocked until this is fixed.

Unmaintained UNIC Unicode tables used through urlpattern 0.3 -> tauri-utils. Included on macOS. This is an upstream maintenance risk, not a reported exploitable vulnerability in this advisory; track a compatible upstream replacement instead of patching Unicode semantics locally.
